host.cpu: Intel Xeon Processor (Skylake, IBRS, no TSX)

i8086.caveat: The boot row uses DOS service hooks; none of these rows measures the wired Harris board. The core and synthetic machine rows execute a fixed instruction mix. Shared-host variance is substantial.

i80386Xv6.command: XV6_LEAN=1 XV6_RAM_HASH=1 XV6_FIRMWARE=bochs XV6_STEPS=40000000 XV6_STOP_ON_EXPECT=1 XV6_COMMAND=$'forktest\r' XV6_EXPECT_SERIAL=$'fork test OK\n$ ' node scripts/probe-xv6-stock.mjs
i80386Xv6.caveat: The six-cycle instruction charge and 6 MHz clock are a deterministic device-scheduling convention, not measured Intel 80386DX timings. Configured virtual-time factors are not physical 386DX RTx. Same guest step count, output, board cycles, and RAM hash were observed in both modes. Wall times varied on the shared VPS.
